Public Shared Function EqualText(left As String, right As String) As Boolean
            Dim options As CompareOptions = CompareOptions.IgnoreCase Or CompareOptions.IgnoreKanaType Or CompareOptions.IgnoreWidth
            Return CultureInfo.CurrentCulture.CompareInfo.Compare(If(left, String.Empty), If(right, String.Empty), options) = 0
        End Function

Public Shared Function CellToTrimmedText(ByRef v As Object) As String
            If TypeOf v Is String Then
                Return DirectCast(v, String).Trim()
            End If

            If TypeOf v Is Double OrElse
               TypeOf v Is Single OrElse
               TypeOf v Is Decimal OrElse
               TypeOf v Is Integer OrElse
               TypeOf v Is Long OrElse
               TypeOf v Is Short Then

                Dim d As Double = Convert.ToDouble(v, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                If Double.IsNaN(d) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(d) Then Return ""

                If Math.Abs(d - Math.Round(d)) < 0.000000000001R Then
                    Return CLng(Math.Round(d)).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                End If

                Return d.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
            End If

            Dim s As String = Convert.ToString(v, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
            If s Is Nothing Then Return ""
            Return s.Trim()
        End Function

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function TryPrepareRows(yCol As Object(,), xRaw As Object(,), zRaw As Object(,), subjectCol As Object(,), visitCol As Object(,), zSupplied As Boolean, visitSupplied As Boolean, n As Integer, pX As Integer, pZ As Integer, readNumber As Func(Of Object, Double?), readText As Func(Of Object, String), ByRef prepared As UdfLmmPreparedRows38, ByRef errorMessage As String) As Boolean
            prepared = Nothing
            Dim yList As New List(Of Double)()
            Dim xRows As New List(Of Double())()
            Dim zRows As New List(Of Double())()
            Dim subjectList As New List(Of Object)()
            Dim visitList As New List(Of Double)()
            Dim dropped As Integer = 0

            For i As Integer = 0 To n - 1
                Dim yi As Double? = readNumber(yCol(i, 0))
                Dim subjectText As String = readText(subjectCol(i, 0))
                Dim valid As Boolean = yi.HasValue AndAlso Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(subjectText)

                Dim xRow(pX - 1) As Double
                If valid Then
                    For j As Integer = 0 To pX - 1
                        Dim xij As Double? = readNumber(xRaw(i, j))
                        If Not xij.HasValue Then
                            valid = False
                            Exit For
                        End If
                        xRow(j) = xij.Value
                    Next
                End If

                Dim zRow() As Double = Nothing
                If valid AndAlso zSupplied Then
                    ReDim zRow(pZ - 1)
                    For j As Integer = 0 To pZ - 1
                        Dim zij As Double? = readNumber(zRaw(i, j))
                        If Not zij.HasValue Then
                            valid = False
                            Exit For
                        End If
                        zRow(j) = zij.Value
                    Next
                End If

                Dim vi As Double = Double.NaN
                If valid AndAlso visitSupplied Then
                    Dim parsedVisit As Double? = readNumber(visitCol(i, 0))
                    If Not parsedVisit.HasValue Then
                        valid = False
                    Else
                        vi = parsedVisit.Value
                    End If
                End If

                If valid Then
                    yList.Add(yi.Value)
                    xRows.Add(xRow)
                    If zSupplied Then zRows.Add(zRow)
                    subjectList.Add(subjectText)
                    If visitSupplied Then visitList.Add(vi)
                Else
                    dropped += 1
                End If
            Next

            If yList.Count = 0 Then
                errorMessage = "no valid complete rows remain after removing rows with missing/invalid y, x, z, subject, or visit values."
                Return False
            End If

            Dim xValues(yList.Count - 1, pX - 1) As Double
            For i As Integer = 0 To yList.Count - 1
                For j As Integer = 0 To pX - 1
                    xValues(i, j) = xRows(i)(j)
                Next
            Next

            Dim zValues(,) As Double = Nothing
            If zSupplied Then
                ReDim zValues(yList.Count - 1, pZ - 1)
                For i As Integer = 0 To yList.Count - 1
                    For j As Integer = 0 To pZ - 1
                        zValues(i, j) = zRows(i)(j)
                    Next
                Next
            End If

            Dim finalVisit() As Double = Nothing
            If visitSupplied Then finalVisit = visitList.ToArray()

            prepared = New UdfLmmPreparedRows38 With {
                .Y = yList.ToArray(),
                .X = xValues,
                .Z = zValues,
                .Subject = subjectList.ToArray(),
                .Visit = finalVisit,
                .DroppedRows = dropped
            }
            Return True

Public Shared Function TryPrepareRows(yCol As Object(,), xRaw As Object(,), zRaw As Object(,), subjectCol As Object(,), visitCol As Object(,), zSupplied As Boolean, visitSupplied As Boolean, n As Integer, pX As Integer, pZ As Integer, readNumber As Func(Of Object, Double?), readText As Func(Of Object, String), ByRef prepared As UdfLmmPreparedRows38, ByRef errorMessage As String) As Boolean
            prepared = Nothing
            Dim yList As New List(Of Double)()
            Dim xRows As New List(Of Double())()
            Dim zRows As New List(Of Double())()
            Dim subjectList As New List(Of Object)()
            Dim visitList As New List(Of Double)()
            Dim dropped As Integer = 0

            For i As Integer = 0 To n - 1
                Dim yi As Double? = readNumber(yCol(i, 0))
                Dim subjectText As String = readText(subjectCol(i, 0))
                Dim valid As Boolean = yi.HasValue AndAlso Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(subjectText)

                Dim xRow(pX - 1) As Double
                If valid Then
                    For j As Integer = 0 To pX - 1
                        Dim xij As Double? = readNumber(xRaw(i, j))
                        If Not xij.HasValue Then
                            valid = False
                            Exit For
                        End If
                        xRow(j) = xij.Value
                    Next
                End If

                Dim zRow() As Double = Nothing
                If valid AndAlso zSupplied Then
                    ReDim zRow(pZ - 1)
                    For j As Integer = 0 To pZ - 1
                        Dim zij As Double? = readNumber(zRaw(i, j))
                        If Not zij.HasValue Then
                            valid = False
                            Exit For
                        End If
                        zRow(j) = zij.Value
                    Next
                End If

                Dim vi As Double = Double.NaN
                If valid AndAlso visitSupplied Then
                    Dim parsedVisit As Double? = readNumber(visitCol(i, 0))
                    If Not parsedVisit.HasValue Then
                        valid = False
                    Else
                        vi = parsedVisit.Value
                    End If
                End If

                If valid Then
                    yList.Add(yi.Value)
                    xRows.Add(xRow)
                    If zSupplied Then zRows.Add(zRow)
                    subjectList.Add(subjectText)
                    If visitSupplied Then visitList.Add(vi)
                Else
                    dropped += 1
                End If
            Next

            If yList.Count = 0 Then
                errorMessage = "no valid complete rows remain after removing rows with missing/invalid y, x, z, subject, or visit values."
                Return False
            End If

            Dim xValues(yList.Count - 1, pX - 1) As Double
            For i As Integer = 0 To yList.Count - 1
                For j As Integer = 0 To pX - 1
                    xValues(i, j) = xRows(i)(j)
                Next
            Next

            Dim zValues(,) As Double = Nothing
            If zSupplied Then
                ReDim zValues(yList.Count - 1, pZ - 1)
                For i As Integer = 0 To yList.Count - 1
                    For j As Integer = 0 To pZ - 1
                        zValues(i, j) = zRows(i)(j)
                    Next
                Next
            End If

            Dim finalVisit() As Double = Nothing
            If visitSupplied Then finalVisit = visitList.ToArray()

            prepared = New UdfLmmPreparedRows38 With {
                .Y = yList.ToArray(),
                .X = xValues,
                .Z = zValues,
                .Subject = subjectList.ToArray(),
                .Visit = finalVisit,
                .DroppedRows = dropped
            }
            Return True
        End Function

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function TryBuildExpandedDesign(raw As Double(,), rawNames As String(), formulaText As String, absoluteColumnLetters As String(), allowRelativeColumnLetters As Boolean, allowAbsoluteColumnLetters As Boolean, allowQuotedVariableNames As Boolean, role As String, fallbackPrefix As String, ByRef design As Double(,), ByRef designNames As String(), ByRef errorMessage As String) As Boolean
            design = Nothing
            designNames = New String() {}
            errorMessage = Nothing

            If raw Is Nothing OrElse raw.GetLength(0) <= 0 OrElse raw.GetLength(1) <= 0 Then
                errorMessage = role & " requires a non-empty predictor matrix."
                Return False
            End If

            Dim p As Integer = raw.GetLength(1)
            Dim prefix As String = If(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(fallbackPrefix), "X", fallbackPrefix.Trim())
            Dim names() As String = LmmUDFsMetadata38.NormalizeNameList(rawNames, p, prefix)

            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(formulaText) Then
                design = raw
                designNames = names
                Return True
            End If

            Dim designBuild As RegressionFormulaMatrixBuildResult = Nothing
            Dim designErr As String = Nothing

            If Not RegressionFormulaDesignService.TryBuildExpandedPredictorMatrixFromFormula(rawX:=raw,
                                                                                            result:=designBuild,
                                                                                            errorMessage:=designErr,
                                                                                            predictorNames:=names,
                                                                                            formulaText:=formulaText,
                                                                                            absoluteColumnLetters:=absoluteColumnLetters,
                                                                                            allowRelativeColumnLetters:=allowRelativeColumnLetters,
                                                                                            allowAbsoluteColumnLetters:=allowAbsoluteColumnLetters,
                                                                                            allowQuotedVariableNames:=allowQuotedVariableNames,
                                                                                            omitCategoricalReference:=True) Then
                errorMessage = role & " could not be parsed or expanded: " & If(designErr, String.Empty)
                Return False
            End If

            If designBuild Is Nothing OrElse designBuild.ExpandedPredictorMatrix Is Nothing OrElse designBuild.ExpandedPredictorMatrix.GetLength(1) <= 0 Then
                errorMessage = role & " expansion did not produce any design columns."
                Return False
            End If

            design = designBuild.ExpandedPredictorMatrix
            designNames = If(designBuild.ExpandedPredictorNames, New String() {})
            If designNames.Length <> design.GetLength(1) Then designNames = Global.BESHStatNG.ExcelCommon.MixedModelUDFsMetadata38.DefaultNames(design.GetLength(1), prefix)
            Return True
        End Function

Public Shared Function TryBuildExpandedDesign(raw As Double(,), rawNames As String(), formulaText As String, absoluteColumnLetters As String(), allowRelativeColumnLetters As Boolean, allowAbsoluteColumnLetters As Boolean, allowQuotedVariableNames As Boolean, role As String, fallbackPrefix As String, ByRef design As Double(,), ByRef designNames As String(), ByRef errorMessage As String) As Boolean
            design = Nothing
            designNames = New String() {}
            errorMessage = Nothing

            If raw Is Nothing OrElse raw.GetLength(0) <= 0 OrElse raw.GetLength(1) <= 0 Then
                errorMessage = role & " requires a non-empty predictor matrix."
                Return False
            End If

            Dim p As Integer = raw.GetLength(1)
            Dim prefix As String = If(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(fallbackPrefix), "X", fallbackPrefix.Trim())
            Dim names() As String = LmmUDFsMetadata38.NormalizeNameList(rawNames, p, prefix)

            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(formulaText) Then
                design = raw
                designNames = names
                Return True
            End If

            Dim designBuild As RegressionFormulaMatrixBuildResult = Nothing
            Dim designErr As String = Nothing

            If Not RegressionFormulaDesignService.TryBuildExpandedPredictorMatrixFromFormula(rawX:=raw,
                                                                                            result:=designBuild,
                                                                                            errorMessage:=designErr,
                                                                                            predictorNames:=names,
                                                                                            formulaText:=formulaText,
                                                                                            absoluteColumnLetters:=absoluteColumnLetters,
                                                                                            allowRelativeColumnLetters:=allowRelativeColumnLetters,
                                                                                            allowAbsoluteColumnLetters:=allowAbsoluteColumnLetters,
                                                                                            allowQuotedVariableNames:=allowQuotedVariableNames,
                                                                                            omitCategoricalReference:=True) Then
                errorMessage = role & " could not be parsed or expanded: " & If(designErr, String.Empty)
                Return False
            End If

            If designBuild Is Nothing OrElse designBuild.ExpandedPredictorMatrix Is Nothing OrElse designBuild.ExpandedPredictorMatrix.GetLength(1) <= 0 Then
                errorMessage = role & " expansion did not produce any design columns."
                Return False
            End If

            design = designBuild.ExpandedPredictorMatrix
            designNames = If(designBuild.ExpandedPredictorNames, New String() {})
            If designNames.Length <> design.GetLength(1) Then designNames = Global.BESHStatNG.ExcelCommon.MixedModelUDFsMetadata38.DefaultNames(design.GetLength(1), prefix)
            Return True
        End Function

Public Shared Function AddInterceptColumn(expandedX As Double(,), nRows As Integer) As Double(,)
            Dim p As Integer = If(expandedX Is Nothing, 0, expandedX.GetLength(1))
            Dim out(nRows - 1, p) As Double

            For i As Integer = 0 To nRows - 1
                out(i, 0) = 1.0
            Next

            If p > 0 Then
                For i As Integer = 0 To nRows - 1
                    For j As Integer = 0 To p - 1
                        out(i, j + 1) = expandedX(i, j)
                    Next
                Next
            End If

            Return out
        End Function

Public Shared Function GeeFindHeaderIndex(headers() As String, ParamArray acceptedNames() As String) As Integer
            If headers Is Nothing OrElse acceptedNames Is Nothing Then Return -1
            For i As Integer = 0 To headers.Length - 1
                Dim h As String = GeeNormalizeDesignColumnName(headers(i))
                For Each accepted As String In acceptedNames
                    If String.Equals(h, GeeNormalizeDesignColumnName(accepted), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then Return i
                Next
            Next
            Return -1
        End Function

Public Shared Function GeeFindDesignColumnIndex(names() As String, requestedName As String) As Integer
            If names Is Nothing OrElse String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(requestedName) Then Return -1
            For i As Integer = 0 To names.Length - 1
                If String.Equals(names(i), requestedName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then Return i
            Next
            Dim wanted As String = GeeNormalizeDesignColumnName(requestedName)
            For i As Integer = 0 To names.Length - 1
                If String.Equals(GeeNormalizeDesignColumnName(names(i)), wanted, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then Return i
            Next
            Return -1
        End Function

Public Shared Function BuildParameterNames(predictorNames() As String, coefficientCount As Integer) As String()
            If coefficientCount < 1 Then Return New String() {}

            Dim out(coefficientCount - 1) As String
            out(0) = "Intercept"
            Dim source() As String = If(predictorNames, New String() {})
            For i As Integer = 1 To coefficientCount - 1
                Dim srcIndex As Integer = i - 1
                If srcIndex < source.Length Then
                    out(i) = source(srcIndex)
                Else
                    out(i) = "Param" & (i + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                End If
            Next
            Return out
        End Function

Public Shared Function GetVariableNames(expectedCount As Integer,
                                                isMissing As Func(Of Boolean),
                                                scalarText As Func(Of String),
                                                acquireRange As Func(Of UdfVariableNameRange38)) As String()
            If expectedCount <= 0 Then Return New String() {}

            Dim fallback(expectedCount - 1) As String
            For i As Integer = 0 To expectedCount - 1
                fallback(i) = "X" & (i + 1).ToString()
            Next

            If isMissing() Then Return fallback

            Dim s As String = scalarText()
            If s IsNot Nothing Then
                Dim parts As String() = s.Split({","c}, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)
                If parts.Length = expectedCount Then
                    For i As Integer = 0 To expectedCount - 1
                        parts(i) = parts(i).Trim()
                        If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(parts(i)) Then parts(i) = fallback(i)
                    Next
                    Return parts
                End If
            End If

            Dim arr As UdfVariableNameRange38 = acquireRange()
            If arr Is Nothing Then Return fallback

            Dim rows As Integer = arr.RowCount
            Dim cols As Integer = arr.ColumnCount
            Dim list As New List(Of String)()

            If rows = 1 AndAlso cols >= 1 Then
                For j As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                    list.Add(arr.ReadText(0, j))
                Next
            ElseIf cols = 1 AndAlso rows >= 1 Then
                For i As Integer = 0 To rows - 1
                    list.Add(arr.ReadText(i, 0))
                Next
            End If

            If list.Count = expectedCount Then
                For i As Integer = 0 To expectedCount - 1
                    If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(list(i)) Then list(i) = fallback(i)
                Next
                Return list.ToArray()
            End If

            Return fallback
        End Function

Public Shared Sub ApplyGeeAtProfile(Of TComponent As UdfGeeComponent38(Of TValue), TProfile As UdfGeeAtProfile38(Of TValue), TValue As {UdfLsmProfileValue38, New})(
            components As List(Of TComponent), atProfile As TProfile)
            If components Is Nothing OrElse atProfile Is Nothing Then Exit Sub

            For Each component As TComponent In components
                If component Is Nothing Then Continue For

                If Not component.TimeSpecified AndAlso atProfile.TimeSpecified Then
                    component.TimeSpecified = True
                    component.TimeValue = atProfile.TimeValue
                End If

                For Each atValue As TValue In atProfile.ProfileValues
                    If Not GeeComponentHasProfileColumn(Of TComponent, TValue)(component, atValue.ColumnIndex) Then
                        component.ProfileValues.Add(New TValue With {
                            .Name = atValue.Name,
                            .ColumnIndex = atValue.ColumnIndex,
                            .Value = atValue.Value
                        })
                    End If
                Next
            Next
        End Sub

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function TryGetGeeAtSpec(Of TProfile As {UdfGeeAtProfile38(Of TValue), New}, TValue As {UdfLsmProfileValue38, New})(
            arr As Object(,), parameterNames As String(),
            isBlank As Func(Of Object, Boolean), cellText As Func(Of Object, String), tryFinite As FiniteDoubleReader,
            ByRef atProfile As TProfile, ByRef errorMessage As String) As Boolean
            Dim rows As Integer = arr.GetLength(0)
            Dim cols As Integer = arr.GetLength(1)
            If rows < 2 OrElse cols < 1 Then
                errorMessage = "at must contain a header row and at least one data row, or be omitted."
                Return False
            End If

            Dim header(cols - 1) As String
            For c As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                header(c) = cellText(arr(0, c))
            Next

            Dim nameCol As Integer = GEEUDFsMetadata38.GeeFindHeaderIndex(header, "name", "variable", "effect", "column", "profile", "at")
            Dim valueCol As Integer = GEEUDFsMetadata38.GeeFindHeaderIndex(header, "value", "val", "setting", "atvalue")
            Dim parsed As New TProfile()

            If nameCol >= 0 AndAlso valueCol >= 0 AndAlso nameCol <> valueCol Then
                For r As Integer = 1 To rows - 1
                    Dim rowHasAny As Boolean = False
                    For c As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                        If Not isBlank(arr(r, c)) Then
                            rowHasAny = True
                            Exit For
                        End If
                    Next
                    If Not rowHasAny Then Continue For

                    Dim requestedName As String = cellText(arr(r, nameCol))
                    If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(requestedName) Then
                        errorMessage = "at row " & (r + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & " has a missing name/variable value."
                        Return False
                    End If

                    Dim value As Double
                    If Not tryFinite(arr(r, valueCol), value) Then
                        errorMessage = "at row " & (r + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) &
                                       " has a missing or nonnumeric value for """ & requestedName & """."
                        Return False
                    End If

                    If Not AddGeeAtValue(Of TProfile, TValue)(parsed, parameterNames, requestedName, value,
                                                    "at row " & (r + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                                                    errorMessage) Then
                        Return False
                    End If
                Next
            Else
                Dim profileColumns As New List(Of KeyValuePair(Of Integer, Integer))()
                Dim timeCol As Integer = GEEUDFsMetadata38.GeeFindHeaderIndex(header, "time", "visit")

                For c As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                    If c = timeCol Then Continue For
                    If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(header(c)) Then Continue For

                    Dim idx As Integer = GEEUDFsMetadata38.GeeFindDesignColumnIndex(parameterNames, header(c))
                    If idx < 0 Then
                        errorMessage = "at column header """ & header(c) & """ was not found among fitted design columns: " &
                                       String.Join(", ", parameterNames) & ". Use header 'time' for the fitted time/order column."
                        Return False
                    End If

                    profileColumns.Add(New KeyValuePair(Of Integer, Integer)(c, idx))
                Next

                If timeCol < 0 AndAlso profileColumns.Count = 0 Then
                    errorMessage = "at must contain either name/value headers or at least one time/design-column header."
                    Return False
                End If

                Dim dataRow As Integer = -1
                For r As Integer = 1 To rows - 1
                    Dim rowHasAny As Boolean = False
                    For c As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                        If Not isBlank(arr(r, c)) Then
                            rowHasAny = True
                            Exit For
                        End If
                    Next
                    If Not rowHasAny Then Continue For

                    If dataRow >= 0 Then
                        errorMessage = "wide-form at ranges must contain exactly one nonblank data row. Use name/value form for multiple AT settings by row."
                        Return False
                    End If
                    dataRow = r
                Next

                If dataRow < 0 Then
                    errorMessage = "at does not contain any nonblank data row."
                    Return False
                End If

                If timeCol >= 0 AndAlso Not isBlank(arr(dataRow, timeCol)) Then
                    Dim timeValue As Double
                    If Not tryFinite(arr(dataRow, timeCol), timeValue) Then
                        errorMessage = "at time value must be numeric and finite."
                        Return False
                    End If

                    If Not AddGeeAtValue(Of TProfile, TValue)(parsed, parameterNames, "time", timeValue, "at time column", errorMessage) Then
                        Return False
                    End If
                End If

                For Each pair As KeyValuePair(Of Integer, Integer) In profileColumns
                    If isBlank(arr(dataRow, pair.Key)) Then Continue For

                    Dim profileValue As Double
                    If Not tryFinite(arr(dataRow, pair.Key), profileValue) Then
                        errorMessage = "at value for column """ & header(pair.Key) & """ must be numeric and finite."
                        Return False
                    End If

                    If Not AddGeeAtValue(Of TProfile, TValue)(parsed, parameterNames, parameterNames(pair.Value), profileValue,
                                                    "at column """ & header(pair.Key) & """", errorMessage) Then
                        Return False
                    End If
                Next
            End If

            If Not parsed.TimeSpecified AndAlso parsed.ProfileValues.Count = 0 Then
                errorMessage = "at does not specify any nonblank time or fitted design-column values."
                Return False
            End If

            atProfile = parsed
            Return True
        End Function

Public Shared Function TryGetGeeAtSpec(Of TProfile As {UdfGeeAtProfile38(Of TValue), New}, TValue As {UdfLsmProfileValue38, New})(
            arr As Object(,), parameterNames As String(),
            isBlank As Func(Of Object, Boolean), cellText As Func(Of Object, String), tryFinite As FiniteDoubleReader,
            ByRef atProfile As TProfile, ByRef errorMessage As String) As Boolean
            Dim rows As Integer = arr.GetLength(0)
            Dim cols As Integer = arr.GetLength(1)
            If rows < 2 OrElse cols < 1 Then
                errorMessage = "at must contain a header row and at least one data row, or be omitted."
                Return False
            End If

            Dim header(cols - 1) As String
            For c As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                header(c) = cellText(arr(0, c))
            Next

            Dim nameCol As Integer = GEEUDFsMetadata38.GeeFindHeaderIndex(header, "name", "variable", "effect", "column", "profile", "at")
            Dim valueCol As Integer = GEEUDFsMetadata38.GeeFindHeaderIndex(header, "value", "val", "setting", "atvalue")
            Dim parsed As New TProfile()

            If nameCol >= 0 AndAlso valueCol >= 0 AndAlso nameCol <> valueCol Then
                For r As Integer = 1 To rows - 1
                    Dim rowHasAny As Boolean = False
                    For c As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                        If Not isBlank(arr(r, c)) Then
                            rowHasAny = True
                            Exit For
                        End If
                    Next
                    If Not rowHasAny Then Continue For

                    Dim requestedName As String = cellText(arr(r, nameCol))
                    If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(requestedName) Then
                        errorMessage = "at row " & (r + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & " has a missing name/variable value."
                        Return False
                    End If

                    Dim value As Double
                    If Not tryFinite(arr(r, valueCol), value) Then
                        errorMessage = "at row " & (r + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) &
                                       " has a missing or nonnumeric value for """ & requestedName & """."
                        Return False
                    End If

                    If Not AddGeeAtValue(Of TProfile, TValue)(parsed, parameterNames, requestedName, value,
                                                    "at row " & (r + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                                                    errorMessage) Then
                        Return False
                    End If
                Next
            Else
                Dim profileColumns As New List(Of KeyValuePair(Of Integer, Integer))()
                Dim timeCol As Integer = GEEUDFsMetadata38.GeeFindHeaderIndex(header, "time", "visit")

                For c As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                    If c = timeCol Then Continue For
                    If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(header(c)) Then Continue For

                    Dim idx As Integer = GEEUDFsMetadata38.GeeFindDesignColumnIndex(parameterNames, header(c))
                    If idx < 0 Then
                        errorMessage = "at column header """ & header(c) & """ was not found among fitted design columns: " &
                                       String.Join(", ", parameterNames) & ". Use header 'time' for the fitted time/order column."
                        Return False
                    End If

                    profileColumns.Add(New KeyValuePair(Of Integer, Integer)(c, idx))
                Next

                If timeCol < 0 AndAlso profileColumns.Count = 0 Then
                    errorMessage = "at must contain either name/value headers or at least one time/design-column header."
                    Return False
                End If

                Dim dataRow As Integer = -1
                For r As Integer = 1 To rows - 1
                    Dim rowHasAny As Boolean = False
                    For c As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                        If Not isBlank(arr(r, c)) Then
                            rowHasAny = True
                            Exit For
                        End If
                    Next
                    If Not rowHasAny Then Continue For

                    If dataRow >= 0 Then
                        errorMessage = "wide-form at ranges must contain exactly one nonblank data row. Use name/value form for multiple AT settings by row."
                        Return False
                    End If
                    dataRow = r
                Next

                If dataRow < 0 Then
                    errorMessage = "at does not contain any nonblank data row."
                    Return False
                End If

                If timeCol >= 0 AndAlso Not isBlank(arr(dataRow, timeCol)) Then
                    Dim timeValue As Double
                    If Not tryFinite(arr(dataRow, timeCol), timeValue) Then
                        errorMessage = "at time value must be numeric and finite."
                        Return False
                    End If

                    If Not AddGeeAtValue(Of TProfile, TValue)(parsed, parameterNames, "time", timeValue, "at time column", errorMessage) Then
                        Return False
                    End If
                End If

                For Each pair As KeyValuePair(Of Integer, Integer) In profileColumns
                    If isBlank(arr(dataRow, pair.Key)) Then Continue For

                    Dim profileValue As Double
                    If Not tryFinite(arr(dataRow, pair.Key), profileValue) Then
                        errorMessage = "at value for column """ & header(pair.Key) & """ must be numeric and finite."
                        Return False
                    End If

                    If Not AddGeeAtValue(Of TProfile, TValue)(parsed, parameterNames, parameterNames(pair.Value), profileValue,
                                                    "at column """ & header(pair.Key) & """", errorMessage) Then
                        Return False
                    End If
                Next
            End If

            If Not parsed.TimeSpecified AndAlso parsed.ProfileValues.Count = 0 Then
                errorMessage = "at does not specify any nonblank time or fitted design-column values."
                Return False
            End If

            atProfile = parsed
            Return True
        End Function

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function AddGeeAtValue(Of TProfile As UdfGeeAtProfile38(Of TValue), TValue As {UdfLsmProfileValue38, New})(
            atProfile As TProfile, parameterNames As String(), requestedName As String, value As Double,
            sourceDescription As String, ByRef errorMessage As String) As Boolean
            If atProfile Is Nothing Then
                errorMessage = "internal error: AT profile was not initialized."
                Return False
            End If

            If String.Equals(GEEUDFsMetadata38.GeeNormalizeDesignColumnName(requestedName), GEEUDFsMetadata38.GeeNormalizeDesignColumnName("time"), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) OrElse
               String.Equals(GEEUDFsMetadata38.GeeNormalizeDesignColumnName(requestedName), GEEUDFsMetadata38.GeeNormalizeDesignColumnName("visit"), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then
                If atProfile.TimeSpecified Then
                    errorMessage = "at specifies time more than once."
                    Return False
                End If
                atProfile.TimeSpecified = True
                atProfile.TimeValue = value
                Return True
            End If

            Dim idx As Integer = GEEUDFsMetadata38.GeeFindDesignColumnIndex(parameterNames, requestedName)
            If idx < 0 Then
                errorMessage = sourceDescription & " names """ & requestedName & """, which was not found among fitted design columns: " &
                               String.Join(", ", parameterNames) & "."
                Return False
            End If

            For Each existing As TValue In atProfile.ProfileValues
                If existing.ColumnIndex = idx Then
                    errorMessage = "at specifies design column """ & parameterNames(idx) & """ more than once."
                    Return False
                End If
            Next

            atProfile.ProfileValues.Add(New TValue With {
                .Name = parameterNames(idx),
                .ColumnIndex = idx,
                .Value = value
            })
            Return True
        End Function

Public Shared Function AddGeeAtValue(Of TProfile As UdfGeeAtProfile38(Of TValue), TValue As {UdfLsmProfileValue38, New})(
            atProfile As TProfile, parameterNames As String(), requestedName As String, value As Double,
            sourceDescription As String, ByRef errorMessage As String) As Boolean
            If atProfile Is Nothing Then
                errorMessage = "internal error: AT profile was not initialized."
                Return False
            End If

            If String.Equals(GEEUDFsMetadata38.GeeNormalizeDesignColumnName(requestedName), GEEUDFsMetadata38.GeeNormalizeDesignColumnName("time"), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) OrElse
               String.Equals(GEEUDFsMetadata38.GeeNormalizeDesignColumnName(requestedName), GEEUDFsMetadata38.GeeNormalizeDesignColumnName("visit"), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then
                If atProfile.TimeSpecified Then
                    errorMessage = "at specifies time more than once."
                    Return False
                End If
                atProfile.TimeSpecified = True
                atProfile.TimeValue = value
                Return True
            End If

            Dim idx As Integer = GEEUDFsMetadata38.GeeFindDesignColumnIndex(parameterNames, requestedName)
            If idx < 0 Then
                errorMessage = sourceDescription & " names """ & requestedName & """, which was not found among fitted design columns: " &
                               String.Join(", ", parameterNames) & "."
                Return False
            End If

            For Each existing As TValue In atProfile.ProfileValues
                If existing.ColumnIndex = idx Then
                    errorMessage = "at specifies design column """ & parameterNames(idx) & """ more than once."
                    Return False
                End If
            Next

            atProfile.ProfileValues.Add(New TValue With {
                .Name = parameterNames(idx),
                .ColumnIndex = idx,
                .Value = value
            })
            Return True
        End Function

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function TryGetGeeSpec(Of TComponent As {UdfGeeComponent38(Of TValue), New}, TValue As {UdfLsmProfileValue38, New})(
            arr As Object(,), parameterNames As String(), isBlank As Func(Of Object, Boolean), cellText As Func(Of Object, String), tryFinite As FiniteDoubleReader,
            ByRef components As List(Of TComponent), ByRef errorMessage As String) As Boolean
            Dim rows As Integer = arr.GetLength(0)
            Dim cols As Integer = arr.GetLength(1)
            If rows < 2 OrElse cols < 2 Then
                errorMessage = "spec must contain a header row and at least one data row."
                Return False
            End If

            Dim header(cols - 1) As String
            For c As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                header(c) = cellText(arr(0, c))
            Next

            Dim labelCol As Integer = GEEUDFsMetadata38.GeeFindHeaderIndex(header, "label", "contrast", "estimate", "name")
            Dim weightCol As Integer = GEEUDFsMetadata38.GeeFindHeaderIndex(header, "weight", "coef", "coefficient", "contrastweight")
            Dim timeCol As Integer = GEEUDFsMetadata38.GeeFindHeaderIndex(header, "time", "visit")

            If weightCol < 0 Then
                errorMessage = "spec header must include a weight column."
                Return False
            End If

            Dim profileColumns As New List(Of KeyValuePair(Of Integer, Integer))()
            For c As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                If c = labelCol OrElse c = weightCol OrElse c = timeCol Then Continue For
                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(header(c)) Then Continue For

                Dim idx As Integer = GEEUDFsMetadata38.GeeFindDesignColumnIndex(parameterNames, header(c))
                If idx < 0 Then
                    errorMessage = "profile column header """ & header(c) & """ was not found among fitted design columns: " &
                                   String.Join(", ", parameterNames) & ". Use header 'time' for the fitted time/order column."
                    Return False
                End If

                If String.Equals(parameterNames(idx), "Intercept", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) OrElse
                   String.Equals(parameterNames(idx), "(Intercept)", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then
                    errorMessage = "the intercept column should not be used as a profile column; it is supplied automatically by the fitted design."
                    Return False
                End If

                profileColumns.Add(New KeyValuePair(Of Integer, Integer)(c, idx))
            Next

            If profileColumns.Count = 0 AndAlso timeCol < 0 Then
                errorMessage = "spec must include at least one profile column: time and/or a fitted design column name."
                Return False
            End If

            Dim defaultIndex As Integer = 1
            For r As Integer = 1 To rows - 1
                Dim rowHasAny As Boolean = False
                For c As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                    If Not isBlank(arr(r, c)) Then
                        rowHasAny = True
                        Exit For
                    End If
                Next
                If Not rowHasAny Then Continue For

                Dim w As Double
                If Not tryFinite(arr(r, weightCol), w) Then
                    errorMessage = "spec row " & (r + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & " has a missing or nonnumeric weight."
                    Return False
                End If

                Dim label As String = Nothing
                If labelCol >= 0 Then label = cellText(arr(r, labelCol))
                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(label) Then label = "Estimate " & defaultIndex.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)

                Dim comp As New TComponent With {
                    .Label = label,
                    .Weight = w,
                    .TimeSpecified = False,
                    .TimeValue = Double.NaN
                }

                If timeCol >= 0 AndAlso Not isBlank(arr(r, timeCol)) Then
                    Dim tv As Double
                    If Not tryFinite(arr(r, timeCol), tv) Then
                        errorMessage = "spec row " & (r + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & " has a nonnumeric time value."
                        Return False
                    End If
                    comp.TimeSpecified = True
                    comp.TimeValue = tv
                End If

                For Each pair As KeyValuePair(Of Integer, Integer) In profileColumns
                    If isBlank(arr(r, pair.Key)) Then Continue For

                    Dim profileValue As Double
                    If Not tryFinite(arr(r, pair.Key), profileValue) Then
                        errorMessage = "spec row " & (r + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) &
                                       " has a nonnumeric value for profile column """ & header(pair.Key) & """."
                        Return False
                    End If

                    comp.ProfileValues.Add(New TValue With {
                        .Name = parameterNames(pair.Value),
                        .ColumnIndex = pair.Value,
                        .Value = profileValue
                    })
                Next

                components.Add(comp)
                defaultIndex += 1
            Next

            If components.Count = 0 Then
                errorMessage = "spec does not contain any nonblank data rows."
                Return False
            End If

            Return True
        End Function

Public Shared Function TryGetGeeSpec(Of TComponent As {UdfGeeComponent38(Of TValue), New}, TValue As {UdfLsmProfileValue38, New})(
            arr As Object(,), parameterNames As String(), isBlank As Func(Of Object, Boolean), cellText As Func(Of Object, String), tryFinite As FiniteDoubleReader,
            ByRef components As List(Of TComponent), ByRef errorMessage As String) As Boolean
            Dim rows As Integer = arr.GetLength(0)
            Dim cols As Integer = arr.GetLength(1)
            If rows < 2 OrElse cols < 2 Then
                errorMessage = "spec must contain a header row and at least one data row."
                Return False
            End If

            Dim header(cols - 1) As String
            For c As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                header(c) = cellText(arr(0, c))
            Next

            Dim labelCol As Integer = GEEUDFsMetadata38.GeeFindHeaderIndex(header, "label", "contrast", "estimate", "name")
            Dim weightCol As Integer = GEEUDFsMetadata38.GeeFindHeaderIndex(header, "weight", "coef", "coefficient", "contrastweight")
            Dim timeCol As Integer = GEEUDFsMetadata38.GeeFindHeaderIndex(header, "time", "visit")

            If weightCol < 0 Then
                errorMessage = "spec header must include a weight column."
                Return False
            End If

            Dim profileColumns As New List(Of KeyValuePair(Of Integer, Integer))()
            For c As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                If c = labelCol OrElse c = weightCol OrElse c = timeCol Then Continue For
                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(header(c)) Then Continue For

                Dim idx As Integer = GEEUDFsMetadata38.GeeFindDesignColumnIndex(parameterNames, header(c))
                If idx < 0 Then
                    errorMessage = "profile column header """ & header(c) & """ was not found among fitted design columns: " &
                                   String.Join(", ", parameterNames) & ". Use header 'time' for the fitted time/order column."
                    Return False
                End If

                If String.Equals(parameterNames(idx), "Intercept", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) OrElse
                   String.Equals(parameterNames(idx), "(Intercept)", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then
                    errorMessage = "the intercept column should not be used as a profile column; it is supplied automatically by the fitted design."
                    Return False
                End If

                profileColumns.Add(New KeyValuePair(Of Integer, Integer)(c, idx))
            Next

            If profileColumns.Count = 0 AndAlso timeCol < 0 Then
                errorMessage = "spec must include at least one profile column: time and/or a fitted design column name."
                Return False
            End If

            Dim defaultIndex As Integer = 1
            For r As Integer = 1 To rows - 1
                Dim rowHasAny As Boolean = False
                For c As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                    If Not isBlank(arr(r, c)) Then
                        rowHasAny = True
                        Exit For
                    End If
                Next
                If Not rowHasAny Then Continue For

                Dim w As Double
                If Not tryFinite(arr(r, weightCol), w) Then
                    errorMessage = "spec row " & (r + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & " has a missing or nonnumeric weight."
                    Return False
                End If

                Dim label As String = Nothing
                If labelCol >= 0 Then label = cellText(arr(r, labelCol))
                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(label) Then label = "Estimate " & defaultIndex.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)

                Dim comp As New TComponent With {
                    .Label = label,
                    .Weight = w,
                    .TimeSpecified = False,
                    .TimeValue = Double.NaN
                }

                If timeCol >= 0 AndAlso Not isBlank(arr(r, timeCol)) Then
                    Dim tv As Double
                    If Not tryFinite(arr(r, timeCol), tv) Then
                        errorMessage = "spec row " & (r + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & " has a nonnumeric time value."
                        Return False
                    End If
                    comp.TimeSpecified = True
                    comp.TimeValue = tv
                End If

                For Each pair As KeyValuePair(Of Integer, Integer) In profileColumns
                    If isBlank(arr(r, pair.Key)) Then Continue For

                    Dim profileValue As Double
                    If Not tryFinite(arr(r, pair.Key), profileValue) Then
                        errorMessage = "spec row " & (r + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) &
                                       " has a nonnumeric value for profile column """ & header(pair.Key) & """."
                        Return False
                    End If

                    comp.ProfileValues.Add(New TValue With {
                        .Name = parameterNames(pair.Value),
                        .ColumnIndex = pair.Value,
                        .Value = profileValue
                    })
                Next

                components.Add(comp)
                defaultIndex += 1
            Next

            If components.Count = 0 Then
                errorMessage = "spec does not contain any nonblank data rows."
                Return False
            End If

            Return True
        End Function

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function TryReadProbabilityThresholdsPrepared(rows As Integer, cols As Integer,
            appendCell As Func(Of Integer, Integer, List(Of Double), Boolean), ByRef thresholds() As Double) As Boolean
        If rows <> 1 AndAlso cols <> 1 Then Return False

        Dim values As New List(Of Double)()
        If rows = 1 Then
            For j As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                If Not appendCell(0, j, values) Then Return False
            Next
        Else
            For i As Integer = 0 To rows - 1
                If Not appendCell(i, 0, values) Then Return False
            Next
        End If

        If values.Count = 0 Then Return True

        values.Sort()
        Dim uniqueValues As New List(Of Double)(values.Count)
        For i As Integer = 0 To values.Count - 1
            If i = 0 OrElse Math.Abs(values(i) - values(i - 1)) > 0.000000000001R Then
                uniqueValues.Add(values(i))
            End If
        Next

        thresholds = uniqueValues.ToArray()
        Return True
        End Function

Public Shared Function GetFormulaAddressingMode(arg As String, defaultMode As String) As String
            Dim s As String = arg
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(s) Then Return defaultMode

            Select Case LegacyUdfText38.CaseToken(s.Trim().ToLowerInvariant(), New String() {"relative", "rel", "x", "absolute", "abs", "worksheet", "names", "name", "quoted", "variables", "varnames"})

Public Shared Function GetRegressionFamilyCode(arg As String) As String
            Dim s As String = arg
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(s) Then Return "Gaussian"

            Select Case LegacyUdfText38.CaseToken(NormalizeRegressionOptionKey(s), New String() {"binomial", "binary", "logistic", "poisson", "count", "negativebinomial", "negativebinom", "negativebin", "negbin", "nb", "nb2", "gaussian", "normal", "gamma"})
                Case "binomial", "binary", "logistic"
                    Return "Binomial"
                Case "poisson", "count"
                    Return "Poisson"
                Case "negativebinomial", "negativebinom", "negativebin", "negbin", "nb", "nb2"
                    Return "NegativeBinomial"
                Case "gaussian", "normal"
                    Return "Gaussian"
                Case "gamma"
                    Return "Gamma"
                Case Else
                    Return Nothing
            End Select
        End Function

Public Shared Function GetRegressionLinkName(arg As String, familyDisplayName As String) As String
            Dim s As String = arg
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(s) Then
                Return Global.BESHStatNG.regression.GetCanonicalLinkFromDisplayName(familyDisplayName)

            Select Case LegacyUdfText38.CaseToken(NormalizeRegressionOptionKey(s), New String() {"logit", "probit", "log", "identity", "id", "sqrt", "squareroot", "inverse", "reciprocal", "power"})
                Case "logit"
                    Return "Logit"
                Case "probit"
                    Return "Probit"
                Case "log"
                    Return "Log"
                Case "identity", "id"
                    Return "Identity"
                Case "sqrt", "squareroot"

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function FindLastNonBlankRow(rows As Integer, columns As Integer, blank As Func(Of Integer, Integer, Boolean)) As Integer

        For i As Integer = rows - 1 To 0 Step -1
            For j As Integer = 0 To columns - 1
                If Not blank(i, j) Then
                    Return i
                End If
            Next
        Next

        Return -1
        End Function

Public Shared Function HasNumericColumnHeader(lastRow As Integer, columns As Integer, blank As Func(Of Integer, Integer, Boolean), numeric As Func(Of Integer, Integer, Boolean)) As Boolean
        If lastRow < 1 Then Return False
        If blank(0, 0) Then Return False
        Dim firstIsNumeric As Boolean = numeric(0, 0)
        Dim secondIsNumeric As Boolean = numeric(1, 0)
        Return (Not firstIsNumeric) AndAlso secondIsNumeric
        End Function

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function HasNumericMatrixHeader(lastRow As Integer, columns As Integer, blank As Func(Of Integer, Integer, Boolean), numeric As Func(Of Integer, Integer, Boolean)) As Boolean
        If lastRow < 1 Then Return False

        Dim cols As Integer = columns
        Dim anyNonBlankNonNumericFirstRow As Boolean = False
        Dim anyNumericFirstRow As Boolean = False
        For j As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
            If blank(0, j) Then Continue For

            If numeric(0, j) Then
                anyNumericFirstRow = True
            Else
                anyNonBlankNonNumericFirstRow = True
            End If
        Next

        ' A real numeric-matrix header should look like labels, not like a data row
        ' with one or more missing numeric values. This prevents explicit data ranges
        ' whose first observation has missing values from being shortened before row-wise
        ' complete-case filtering aligns y, x, subject, and visit.
        If Not anyNonBlankNonNumericFirstRow Then Return False
        If anyNumericFirstRow Then Return False

        For j As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
            If Not numeric(1, j) Then
                Return False
            End If
        Next

        Return True
        End Function

source_record.signature: Public Shared Function Normalize(data As PreferenceData) As PreferenceResult

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function Normalize(data As PreferenceData) As PreferenceResult
            If data Is Nothing Then Return New PreferenceResult(Defaults(), PreferenceStatus.Defaulted,
                PreferencePersistence.SessionOnly, {"preferences.missing"})
            If data.SchemaVersion <> CurrentSchemaVersion Then Return New PreferenceResult(Defaults(),
                PreferenceStatus.UnsupportedVersion, PreferencePersistence.SessionOnly, {"preferences.version.unsupported"})
            Dim codes As New List(Of String)()
            Dim runtime As New AnalysisDefaultsOptions(data.DefaultAlpha.GetValueOrDefault(0.05),
                data.DefaultRandomSeed.GetValueOrDefault(AnalysisDefaultsOptions.NoExplicitRandomSeed))
            If Not data.DefaultAlpha.HasValue Then
                codes.Add("preferences.alpha.missing")
            ElseIf data.DefaultAlpha.Value <> runtime.DefaultAlpha Then
                codes.Add("preferences.alpha.defaulted")
            End If
            If Not data.DefaultRandomSeed.HasValue Then
                codes.Add("preferences.seed.missing")
            ElseIf data.DefaultRandomSeed.Value <> runtime.DefaultRandomSeed Then
                codes.Add("preferences.seed.defaulted")
            End If
            If Not data.TraceEnabled.HasValue Then codes.Add("preferences.trace.missing")
            Dim display As New PValuePresentationSettings()
            If data.PValues Is Nothing Then
                codes.Add("preferences.display.missing")
            Else
                If data.PValues.DecimalPlaces.HasValue Then
                    display.DecimalPlaces = data.PValues.DecimalPlaces.Value
                Else
                    codes.Add("preferences.digits.missing")
                End If
                If data.PValues.SmallValueDisplay.HasValue Then
                    display.SmallValueDisplay = data.PValues.SmallValueDisplay.Value
                Else
                    codes.Add("preferences.mode.missing")
                End If
                display.UseUpperBound = data.PValues.UseUpperBound.GetValueOrDefault(True)
                If Not data.PValues.UseUpperBound.HasValue Then codes.Add("preferences.upper-bound.missing")
                display.EnsureDefaults()
                If data.PValues.DecimalPlaces.HasValue AndAlso data.PValues.DecimalPlaces.Value <> display.DecimalPlaces Then codes.Add("preferences.digits.defaulted")
                If data.PValues.SmallValueDisplay.HasValue AndAlso data.PValues.SmallValueDisplay.Value <> display.SmallValueDisplay Then codes.Add("preferences.mode.defaulted")
            End If
            Return New PreferenceResult(New PreferenceSnapshot(runtime.DefaultAlpha, runtime.DefaultRandomSeed,
                data.TraceEnabled.GetValueOrDefault(True), display), If(codes.Count = 0, PreferenceStatus.Loaded,
                PreferenceStatus.Normalized), PreferencePersistence.SessionOnly, codes)
        End Function

Public Shared Function Normalize(data As PreferenceData) As PreferenceResult
            If data Is Nothing Then Return New PreferenceResult(Defaults(), PreferenceStatus.Defaulted,
                PreferencePersistence.SessionOnly, {"preferences.missing"})
            If data.SchemaVersion <> CurrentSchemaVersion Then Return New PreferenceResult(Defaults(),
                PreferenceStatus.UnsupportedVersion, PreferencePersistence.SessionOnly, {"preferences.version.unsupported"})
            Dim codes As New List(Of String)()
            Dim runtime As New AnalysisDefaultsOptions(data.DefaultAlpha.GetValueOrDefault(0.05),
                data.DefaultRandomSeed.GetValueOrDefault(AnalysisDefaultsOptions.NoExplicitRandomSeed))
            If Not data.DefaultAlpha.HasValue Then
                codes.Add("preferences.alpha.missing")
            ElseIf data.DefaultAlpha.Value <> runtime.DefaultAlpha Then
                codes.Add("preferences.alpha.defaulted")
            End If
            If Not data.DefaultRandomSeed.HasValue Then
                codes.Add("preferences.seed.missing")
            ElseIf data.DefaultRandomSeed.Value <> runtime.DefaultRandomSeed Then
                codes.Add("preferences.seed.defaulted")
            End If
            If Not data.TraceEnabled.HasValue Then codes.Add("preferences.trace.missing")
            Dim display As New PValuePresentationSettings()
            If data.PValues Is Nothing Then
                codes.Add("preferences.display.missing")
            Else
                If data.PValues.DecimalPlaces.HasValue Then
                    display.DecimalPlaces = data.PValues.DecimalPlaces.Value
                Else
                    codes.Add("preferences.digits.missing")
                End If
                If data.PValues.SmallValueDisplay.HasValue Then
                    display.SmallValueDisplay = data.PValues.SmallValueDisplay.Value
                Else
                    codes.Add("preferences.mode.missing")
                End If
                display.UseUpperBound = data.PValues.UseUpperBound.GetValueOrDefault(True)
                If Not data.PValues.UseUpperBound.HasValue Then codes.Add("preferences.upper-bound.missing")
                display.EnsureDefaults()
                If data.PValues.DecimalPlaces.HasValue AndAlso data.PValues.DecimalPlaces.Value <> display.DecimalPlaces Then codes.Add("preferences.digits.defaulted")
                If data.PValues.SmallValueDisplay.HasValue AndAlso data.PValues.SmallValueDisplay.Value <> display.SmallValueDisplay Then codes.Add("preferences.mode.defaulted")
            End If
            Return New PreferenceResult(New PreferenceSnapshot(runtime.DefaultAlpha, runtime.DefaultRandomSeed,
                data.TraceEnabled.GetValueOrDefault(True), display), If(codes.Count = 0, PreferenceStatus.Loaded,
                PreferenceStatus.Normalized), PreferencePersistence.SessionOnly, codes)
        End Function

Public Sub Checkpoint()
            _cancellation.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()
            Dim elapsed As Double = _elapsedMilliseconds()
            If Double.IsNaN(elapsed) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(elapsed) OrElse elapsed < _lastElapsed Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("Elapsed time must be finite, nonnegative and monotonic.")
            End If
            _lastElapsed = elapsed
            If elapsed > _limits.TimeBudgetMilliseconds Then
                Reject("input.time-budget", "timeBudgetMilliseconds", elapsed, _limits.TimeBudgetMilliseconds)
            End If
        End Sub

Public Sub AddRange(rows As Long, columns As Long)
            Checkpoint()
            If rows < 1 OrElse columns < 1 Then
                Reject("input.dimensions", "ranges", rows.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & " x " & columns.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), "positive dimensions")
            End If
            If rows > Long.MaxValue \ columns Then
                Reject("input.cell-overflow", "ranges", rows.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & " x " & columns.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), Long.MaxValue)
            End If
            Dim cells As Long = rows * columns
            If cells > _limits.MaxRangeCells Then Reject("input.range-cells", "maxRangeCells", cells, _limits.MaxRangeCells)
            If RangeCount >= _limits.MaxRanges Then Reject("input.range-count", "maxRanges", CLng(RangeCount) + 1, _limits.MaxRanges)
            If cells > _limits.MaxTotalCells - TotalCells Then
                Reject("input.total-cells", "maxTotalCells", CDec(TotalCells) + CDec(cells), _limits.MaxTotalCells)
            End If
            Dim total As Long = TotalCells + cells
            Dim estimate As Double = CDbl(total) * _limits.EstimatedBytesPerCell
            If estimate > _limits.MaxEstimatedBytes Then Reject("input.estimated-bytes", "maxEstimatedBytes", estimate, _limits.MaxEstimatedBytes)
            _TotalCells = total
            _RangeCount += 1
        End Sub

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function BuildBinaryCrosstabUdfOutput(summary As BinaryClassificationSummary, missingValue As Object,
                                                     Optional includeHeader As Boolean = True) As Object
            Dim rowOffset As Integer = If(includeHeader, 1, 0)
            Dim outRows As Integer = rowOffset + 4
            Dim out(outRows - 1, 3) As Object

            If includeHeader Then
                out(0, 0) = "Observed \ Predicted"
                out(0, 1) = 0
                out(0, 2) = 1
                out(0, 3) = "Recall %"
            End If

            out(rowOffset + 0, 0) = 0
            out(rowOffset + 0, 1) = summary.TN
            out(rowOffset + 0, 2) = summary.FP
            out(rowOffset + 0, 3) = PercentOrMissingValue(summary.Specificity, missingValue)

            out(rowOffset + 1, 0) = 1
            out(rowOffset + 1, 1) = summary.FN
            out(rowOffset + 1, 2) = summary.TP
            out(rowOffset + 1, 3) = PercentOrMissingValue(summary.Sensitivity, missingValue)

            out(rowOffset + 2, 0) = "Precision % / Overall"
            out(rowOffset + 2, 1) = PercentOrMissingValue(summary.NPV, missingValue)
            out(rowOffset + 2, 2) = PercentOrMissingValue(summary.Precision, missingValue)
            out(rowOffset + 2, 3) = PercentOrMissingValue(summary.Accuracy, missingValue)

            out(rowOffset + 3, 0) = "Threshold / Balanced accuracy"
            out(rowOffset + 3, 1) = summary.Threshold
            out(rowOffset + 3, 2) = PercentOrMissingValue(summary.BalancedAccuracy, missingValue)
            out(rowOffset + 3, 3) = PercentOrMissingValue(summary.YoudenJ, missingValue)

            Return UdfSpillPreparation38.NormalizeBlanks(out)
        End Function

Public Shared Function BuildThresholdTableUdfOutput(rows As IList(Of BinaryThresholdRow), missingValue As Object,
                                                     Optional includeHeader As Boolean = True) As Object
            If rows Is Nothing OrElse rows.Count = 0 Then Return missingValue

            Dim rowOffset As Integer = If(includeHeader, 1, 0)
            Dim outRows As Integer = rowOffset + rows.Count
            Dim out(outRows - 1, 13) As Object

            If includeHeader Then
                out(0, 0) = "Threshold"
                out(0, 1) = "TP"
                out(0, 2) = "FP"
                out(0, 3) = "TN"
                out(0, 4) = "FN"
                out(0, 5) = "Sensitivity %"
                out(0, 6) = "Specificity %"
                out(0, 7) = "Precision %"
                out(0, 8) = "Recall %"
                out(0, 9) = "NPV %"
                out(0, 10) = "Accuracy %"
                out(0, 11) = "BalancedAccuracy %"
                out(0, 12) = "YoudenJ %"
                out(0, 13) = "F1 %"
            End If

            For i As Integer = 0 To rows.Count - 1
                Dim r As BinaryThresholdRow = rows(i)
                Dim rr As Integer = rowOffset + i
                out(rr, 0) = r.Threshold
                out(rr, 1) = r.TP
                out(rr, 2) = r.FP
                out(rr, 3) = r.TN
                out(rr, 4) = r.FN
                out(rr, 5) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.Sensitivity, missingValue)
                out(rr, 6) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.Specificity, missingValue)
                out(rr, 7) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.Precision, missingValue)
                out(rr, 8) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.Recall, missingValue)
                out(rr, 9) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.NPV, missingValue)
                out(rr, 10) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.Accuracy, missingValue)
                out(rr, 11) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.BalancedAccuracy, missingValue)
                out(rr, 12) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.YoudenJ, missingValue)
                out(rr, 13) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.F1, missingValue)
            Next

            Return UdfSpillPreparation38.NormalizeBlanks(out)
        End Function

Public Shared Function BuildThresholdTableUdfOutput(rows As IList(Of BinaryThresholdRow), missingValue As Object,
                                                     Optional includeHeader As Boolean = True) As Object
            If rows Is Nothing OrElse rows.Count = 0 Then Return missingValue

            Dim rowOffset As Integer = If(includeHeader, 1, 0)
            Dim outRows As Integer = rowOffset + rows.Count
            Dim out(outRows - 1, 13) As Object

            If includeHeader Then
                out(0, 0) = "Threshold"
                out(0, 1) = "TP"
                out(0, 2) = "FP"
                out(0, 3) = "TN"
                out(0, 4) = "FN"
                out(0, 5) = "Sensitivity %"
                out(0, 6) = "Specificity %"
                out(0, 7) = "Precision %"
                out(0, 8) = "Recall %"
                out(0, 9) = "NPV %"
                out(0, 10) = "Accuracy %"
                out(0, 11) = "BalancedAccuracy %"
                out(0, 12) = "YoudenJ %"
                out(0, 13) = "F1 %"
            End If

            For i As Integer = 0 To rows.Count - 1
                Dim r As BinaryThresholdRow = rows(i)
                Dim rr As Integer = rowOffset + i
                out(rr, 0) = r.Threshold
                out(rr, 1) = r.TP
                out(rr, 2) = r.FP
                out(rr, 3) = r.TN
                out(rr, 4) = r.FN
                out(rr, 5) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.Sensitivity, missingValue)
                out(rr, 6) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.Specificity, missingValue)
                out(rr, 7) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.Precision, missingValue)
                out(rr, 8) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.Recall, missingValue)
                out(rr, 9) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.NPV, missingValue)

                out(rr, 11) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.BalancedAccuracy, missingValue)
                out(rr, 12) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.YoudenJ, missingValue)
                out(rr, 13) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.F1, missingValue)
            Next

            Return UdfSpillPreparation38.NormalizeBlanks(out)
        End Function

Public Shared Function BuildCalibrationTableUdfOutput(rows As IList(Of CalibrationBinSummary), missingValue As Object,
                                                       Optional includeHeader As Boolean = True) As Object
            If rows Is Nothing OrElse rows.Count = 0 Then Return missingValue

            Dim rowOffset As Integer = If(includeHeader, 1, 0)
            Dim outRows As Integer = rowOffset + rows.Count
            Dim out(outRows - 1, 5) As Object

            If includeHeader Then
                out(0, 0) = "Bin"
                out(0, 1) = "N"
                out(0, 2) = "MeanPredicted"
                out(0, 3) = "ObservedRate"
                out(0, 4) = "LowerCI"
                out(0, 5) = "UpperCI"
            End If

            For i As Integer = 0 To rows.Count - 1
                Dim r As CalibrationBinSummary = rows(i)
                Dim rr As Integer = rowOffset + i
                out(rr, 0) = r.BinIndex
                out(rr, 1) = r.N
                out(rr, 2) = r.MeanPredicted
                out(rr, 3) = r.ObservedRate
                out(rr, 4) = r.LowerCI
                out(rr, 5) = r.UpperCI
            Next

            Return UdfSpillPreparation38.NormalizeBlanks(out)
        End Function

            Dim out(fitted.Length - 1 + If(hdr, 1, 0), 1) As Object

Public Shared Function BuildGlmCoefficientTable(beta As Double(), se As Double(), names As String(), hdr As Boolean, alphaValue As Double, interceptIncluded As Boolean) As Object(,)
            Dim outRows As Integer = If(hdr, beta.Length + 1, beta.Length)
            Dim out(outRows - 1, 7) As Object
            Dim zCrit As Double = distributions.ZCritTwoSided(alphaValue)
            Dim ciLabel As String = (100.0R * (1.0R - alphaValue)).ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & "%"
            Dim r0 As Integer = 0

            If hdr Then
                out(0, 0) = "Parameter"
                out(0, 1) = "Type"
                out(0, 2) = "Coef"
                out(0, 3) = "SE"
                out(0, 4) = "Z"
                out(0, 5) = "P-value"
                out(0, 6) = ciLabel & " CI Lower"
                out(0, 7) = ciLabel & " CI Upper"
                r0 = 1
            End If

            For i As Integer = 0 To beta.Length - 1
                Dim z As Double = If(se(i) > 0.0R, beta(i) / se(i), Double.NaN)
                Dim pv As Double = If(se(i) > 0.0R, 2.0R * distributions.PNorm(-Math.Abs(z)), Double.NaN)

                out(r0 + i, 0) = names(i)
                out(r0 + i, 1) = If(interceptIncluded AndAlso i = 0, "Intercept", "Slope")
                out(r0 + i, 2) = beta(i)
                out(r0 + i, 3) = se(i)
                out(r0 + i, 4) = z
                out(r0 + i, 5) = pv
                out(r0 + i, 6) = beta(i) - zCrit * se(i)
                out(r0 + i, 7) = beta(i) + zCrit * se(i)
            Next
            Return out
        End Function

Public Shared Function BuildGlmCoefficientTable(beta As Double(), se As Double(), names As String(), hdr As Boolean, alphaValue As Double, interceptIncluded As Boolean) As Object(,)
            Dim outRows As Integer = If(hdr, beta.Length + 1, beta.Length)
            Dim out(outRows - 1, 7) As Object
            Dim zCrit As Double = distributions.ZCritTwoSided(alphaValue)
            Dim ciLabel As String = (100.0R * (1.0R - alphaValue)).ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & "%"
            Dim r0 As Integer = 0

            If hdr Then
                out(0, 0) = "Parameter"
                out(0, 1) = "Type"
                out(0, 2) = "Coef"
                out(0, 3) = "SE"
                out(0, 4) = "Z"
                out(0, 5) = "P-value"
                out(0, 6) = ciLabel & " CI Lower"
                out(0, 7) = ciLabel & " CI Upper"
                r0 = 1
            End If

            For i As Integer = 0 To beta.Length - 1
                Dim z As Double = If(se(i) > 0.0R, beta(i) / se(i), Double.NaN)
                Dim pv As Double = If(se(i) > 0.0R, 2.0R * distributions.PNorm(-Math.Abs(z)), Double.NaN)

                out(r0 + i, 0) = names(i)
                out(r0 + i, 1) = If(interceptIncluded AndAlso i = 0, "Intercept", "Slope")
                out(r0 + i, 2) = beta(i)
                out(r0 + i, 3) = se(i)
                out(r0 + i, 4) = z
                out(r0 + i, 5) = pv
                out(r0 + i, 6) = beta(i) - zCrit * se(i)
                out(r0 + i, 7) = beta(i) + zCrit * se(i)
            Next
            Return out
        End Function

Public Shared Function BuildRegressionTestsPrefix(labels As String(), vals As Object(,), hdr As Boolean, extraRows As Integer, ByRef r As Integer) As Object(,)
            Dim outRows As Integer = If(hdr, labels.Length + extraRows + 1, labels.Length + extraRows)
            Dim out(outRows - 1, 3) As Object
            r = 0

            If hdr Then
                out(0, 0) = "Item"
                out(0, 1) = "Value"
                out(0, 2) = "df"
                out(0, 3) = "P-value"
                r = 1
            End If

            For i As Integer = 0 To labels.Length - 1
                out(r, 0) = labels(i)
                out(r, 1) = vals(i, 0)
                out(r, 2) = vals(i, 1)
                out(r, 3) = vals(i, 2)
                r += 1
            Next
            Return out
        End Function

Public Shared Function BuildLmCoefficientTable(model As regression.LinearModel, coef As Double(), se As Double(), dfResid As Double, q As Integer, hdr As Boolean, noteCount As Integer, alphaValue As Double) As Object(,)
            Dim outRows As Integer = q + If(hdr, 1, 0) + noteCount
            Dim out(outRows - 1, 7) As Object

            Dim r0 As Integer = 0
            If hdr Then
                out(0, 0) = "Parameter"
                out(0, 1) = "Type"
                out(0, 2) = "Coef"
                out(0, 3) = "SE"
                out(0, 4) = "T"
                out(0, 5) = "P-value"
                out(0, 6) = $"{100.0 * (1.0 - alphaValue):0.##}% CI LCL"
                out(0, 7) = $"{100.0 * (1.0 - alphaValue):0.##}% CI UCL"
                r0 = 1
            End If

            Dim tCrit As Double = distributions.T_Inv_2T(alphaValue, dfResid)
            For i As Integer = 0 To q - 1
                Dim pname As String = If(model.results.bIntercept AndAlso i = 0,
                                         "Intercept",
                                         model.results.varNames(i - If(model.results.bIntercept, 1, 0)))
                Dim tVal As Double = If(se(i) > 0.0, coef(i) / se(i), Double.NaN)
                Dim pVal As Double = If(se(i) > 0.0, distributions.T_2T(Math.Abs(tVal), dfResid), Double.NaN)

                out(r0 + i, 0) = pname
                out(r0 + i, 1) = If(model.results.bIntercept AndAlso i = 0, "Intercept", "Slope")
                out(r0 + i, 2) = coef(i)
                out(r0 + i, 3) = se(i)
                out(r0 + i, 4) = tVal
                out(r0 + i, 5) = pVal
                out(r0 + i, 6) = coef(i) - tCrit * se(i)
                out(r0 + i, 7) = coef(i) + tCrit * se(i)
            Next
            Return out

Public Shared Function BuildLmCoefficientTable(model As regression.LinearModel, coef As Double(), se As Double(), dfResid As Double, q As Integer, hdr As Boolean, noteCount As Integer, alphaValue As Double) As Object(,)
            Dim outRows As Integer = q + If(hdr, 1, 0) + noteCount
            Dim out(outRows - 1, 7) As Object

            Dim r0 As Integer = 0
            If hdr Then
                out(0, 0) = "Parameter"
                out(0, 1) = "Type"
                out(0, 2) = "Coef"
                out(0, 3) = "SE"
                out(0, 4) = "T"
                out(0, 5) = "P-value"
                out(0, 6) = $"{100.0 * (1.0 - alphaValue):0.##}% CI LCL"
                out(0, 7) = $"{100.0 * (1.0 - alphaValue):0.##}% CI UCL"
                r0 = 1
            End If

            Dim tCrit As Double = distributions.T_Inv_2T(alphaValue, dfResid)
            For i As Integer = 0 To q - 1
                Dim pname As String = If(model.results.bIntercept AndAlso i = 0,
                                         "Intercept",
                                         model.results.varNames(i - If(model.results.bIntercept, 1, 0)))
                Dim tVal As Double = If(se(i) > 0.0, coef(i) / se(i), Double.NaN)
                Dim pVal As Double = If(se(i) > 0.0, distributions.T_2T(Math.Abs(tVal), dfResid), Double.NaN)

                out(r0 + i, 0) = pname
                out(r0 + i, 1) = If(model.results.bIntercept AndAlso i = 0, "Intercept", "Slope")
                out(r0 + i, 2) = coef(i)
                out(r0 + i, 3) = se(i)
                out(r0 + i, 4) = tVal
                out(r0 + i, 5) = pVal
                out(r0 + i, 6) = coef(i) - tCrit * se(i)
                out(r0 + i, 7) = coef(i) + tCrit * se(i)
            Next
            Return out
        End Function
